events.detail: In the Raiders' 38-33 win over the Jets, Mike Washington Jr. started, carried 25 times for 83 yards (3.3 per carry, stuffed six times per ESPN), took early-down and goal-line work, and played 63% of the snaps to Jeanty's 37%. Klint Kubiak said, "That's my call, and Ashton is still going to be a big part of our team," and that Jeanty's pregame comments about the Jets were not a factor. Jeanty said he was told during the week that Washington would get more work. No starter has been named for Week 9 at San Francisco.
events.so_what: A planned role change matters more than Washington's inefficient 3.3 a carry. Washington has early-down and goal-line work, which is where TD points live, so he is a live FLEX. Jeanty is a matchup start on receiving yards until Kubiak shows the carries are coming back. ESPN expects a rebound; the Kubiak quote does not promise one.
